kimi.description: Moonshot AI Kimi OCR via vision chat

kimi-k2.6.description: Kimi K2.6 OCR via multimodal Chat Completions
kimi-k2.6.pricingTier: Moonshot AI public API token pricing
kimi-k2.6.pricingNotes: Moonshot AI public pricing lists Kimi K2.6 at $0.95/1M input tokens and $4/1M output tokens. OCR estimates use cache-miss input pricing conservatively; cache discounts, batch discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/use-kimi-vision-model.md documents Kimi image support for PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, a 100 MB request-body/file limit, and recommended image resolution no higher than 4K. AutoShow renders PDFs to page images before calling Kimi OCR.

kimi-k3.description: Kimi K3 OCR via multimodal Chat Completions
kimi-k3.pricingTier: Moonshot AI public API token pricing
kimi-k3.pricingNotes: Moonshot AI public pricing lists Kimi K3 at $3/1M cache-miss input tokens, $0.30/1M cache-hit input tokens, and $15/1M output tokens with flat pay-as-you-go rates and no context tiers. OCR estimates use cache-miss input pricing conservatively. Kimi K3 runs with always-on thinking at the provider default reasoning_effort of max, so the reused Kimi K2.6 page heuristics are provisional until a separately approved paid calibration is available. Cache discounts, batch discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/use-kimi-vision-model.md documents Kimi image support for PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, a 100 MB request-body/file limit, and recommended image resolution no higher than 4K. AutoShow renders PDFs to page images before calling Kimi OCR.
